name: GlassTube
summary: Watch YouTube ad-free on Rokid AR glasses with ring navigation and paired phone+glasses apps
description: GlassTube lets you watch YouTube ad-free on Rokid AR glasses using paired Android apps on your phone and glasses. Navigate with the R08 smart-ring and choose audio-only or audio+video modes. No Google login required.
author: beyondlevi

releases.notes: The link diagnostics traced the failure to the RFCOMM channel not establishing on either side, despite permission and pairing — the signature of a BLE-only bond (SPP needs a Bluetooth Classic bond). This release corrects the phone foreground-service type for Bluetooth and shows the exact connect exception on the glasses HUD. FIX ON YOUR SIDE: pair the phone and glasses over Bluetooth Classic in Android settings (not only via Hi Rokid), then retest.

Diagnostics release for the "Connecting" issue. The glasses HUD now shows exactly why it is not connected (no Bluetooth permission / no paired phone / connecting / waiting for handshake), and fixes a bug where a missing BLUETOOTH_CONNECT killed the connect loop silently. Install both, and read what the glasses HUD now says.

Fixes the phone/glasses link getting stuck at "Connecting".

The transport was CXR-M-only with empty SDK seams, so it never connected. This release switches to a **direct Bluetooth Classic SPP (RFCOMM)** link — phone as server, glasses as client — the mechanism proven by the rokid-volund-os reference (its phone app has no Rokid SDK and connects over SPP).

**Setup:**
1. Pair the glasses with the phone at the OS Bluetooth level (Hi Rokid does this).
2. Install both APKs; grant BLUETOOTH_CONNECT on both.
3. Tap "Connect to glasses" on the phone; the glasses connect and handshake automatically.

APKs are debug builds. See CHANGELOG.md for details.

releases.notes:
First public release. Paired phone + glasses apps building end to end.

**Modes:** audio-only (phone) and audio+video (glasses), ad-free via Piped. Optional Piped subscription feed. 100% R08 ring-navigable HUD.

**APKs (debug):**
- glasstube-phone-0.1.0-debug.apk — install on the Android phone.
- glasstube-glasses-0.1.0-debug.apk — sideload on the Rokid glasses via Hi Rokid.

Debug builds. The Rokid CXR-M SDK binding is left as marked seams; fill them before running on hardware. See README and CHANGELOG for full status and known gaps.

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
About GlassTube

GlassTube is a paired system of Android apps for Rokid AR glasses and your phone that enables ad-free YouTube playback. It uses a direct Bluetooth link for communication and supports two playback modes: audio-only and audio+video.

Key Features

- Ad-free YouTube streaming via Piped/NewPipeExtractor without Google login
- Two playback modes: audio-only (phone plays audio) and audio+video (glasses play video)
- Full navigation using the R08 smart-ring on the glasses
- Phone app manages account, feed, search, and stream resolution
- Glasses render video and handle playback controls

How It Works

- Phone and glasses communicate over Bluetooth Classic SPP
- Phone owns the Piped account and resolves streams
- Glasses connect as a Bluetooth client and display the HUD
- Audio-only mode streams audio from phone to glasses
- Audio+video mode streams video directly to glasses over Wi-Fi

Requirements

- Rokid AR glasses paired with your Android phone via Bluetooth
- Grant Bluetooth permissions on both devices
- Use the R08 smart-ring for navigation

Notes

- Use for personal and educational purposes; ad-free extraction is a gray area legally
- Not affiliated with Google, YouTube, or Rokid
- Optional Piped account unlocks subscription feeds

For more details, visit the [GlassTube GitHub repository](https://github.com/beyondlevi/glasstube).
